events.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
events.blurb: Sir Mick Jagger, the iconic frontman of The Rolling Stones, celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Rock Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young and still commanding the stage! Today we're celebrating the one and only Mick Jagger. What's your favourite Stones track?

events.title: MTV launched 45 years ago
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' being the first music video ever aired.

angles.name: MTV's Big Birthday
angles.copy: Forty-five years ago today, MTV changed the music landscape forever, kicking off with The Buggles' iconic 'Video Killed The Radio Star'. Did it?

events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their groundbreaking debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, featuring classics like 'Supersonic' and 'Live Forever'.

angles.name: Britpop Classic
angles.copy: Thirty-two years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and introduced us to a whole new era of Britpop. What's your top track from this absolute belter?

events.title: Woodstock Festival began 57 years ago
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place from August 15-18, 1969, on a dairy farm in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Peace, Love & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since half a million people descended on a field for three days of peace, love, and music. Happy anniversary, Woodstock!

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of the 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, who passed away on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: The King's Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-nine years ago, the music world lost a true legend. Remembering Elvis Presley and his unparalleled impact on rock and roll.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Today marks 30 years since the passing of influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who died on September 13, 1996, after being shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Enduring Influence
angles.copy: Three decades since we lost one of hip-hop's most profound voices. Remembering Tupac Shakur and his powerful legacy.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Today marks 56 years since the death of guitar icon Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on September 18, 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God's Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-six years ago, the world lost a musical pioneer. Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on September 26, 1969, featuring iconic tracks and that legendary zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Iconic Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in history. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the formidable frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Pretenders' Powerhouse
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever. What's your go-to Pretenders anthem?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the unmistakable voice of Oasis and a successful solo artist, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star's Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite track he's fronted?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released 55 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine', a global anthem for peace, was released 55 years ago on October 11, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A timeless message that resonates just as strongly today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: The first iPod was unveiled 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how we carry and listen to music with '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

angles.name: Music in Your Pocket
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the first iPod changed everything. Remember that click wheel? What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated globally as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred, naturally) to 007 and his incredible cinematic legacy. Which Bond theme is your favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today would have marked the 86th birthday of The Beatles' co-founder, John Lennon, born October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Remembering a Visionary
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're remembering the extraordinary life and timeless music of John Lennon. His message of peace lives on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Sending a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sprawling self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Album of Diversity
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered the eclectic masterpiece that is 'The White Album'. A double LP packed with every style imaginable. What's your hidden gem from it?
